content.text:
No blocking findings.

One low-severity consistency issue: [MemberDeclarations.svelte:52](/Users/jamie/development/exposed-member-summary-20261012/frontend/src/MemberDeclarations.svelte:52) uses JavaScript `.trim()`, which does not remove U+0085. The database normalization explicitly does. An occurrence whose currency contains only U+0085 therefore counts as unknown in the summary but renders a blank-looking currency label in history. This expression existed before the component extraction; the new summary makes its inconsistency visible.

The remaining implementation matches the reviewed requirements: complete ordered history, preserved duplicate occurrences and empty declarations, exact signed per-currency aggregation, category-ID-based support selection, compatible DTO parsing, inclusive UTC date filtering before pagination, resets, and native links retaining search state. Tests meaningfully cover these behaviors. No suites run or files changed.
